provenance: Telephone call, 2026-09-03, Larry's son asking the tier-1 questions from the interview guide and typing Larry's answers as he spoke them. The Camp Zama date question had been promoted to the head of the guide that morning. Raw capture: research/interviews/breakfast-questions.md, annotated in place under each question.
text: I have no idea. He could still be alive for all I know.
researchNotes: Asked what became of Gagne after Larry was flown out. He does not know, and the phrasing carries no suggestion that he later heard of a death - which is consistent with his 2026-09-02 correction that Gagne did not die at Dong Xoai, and inconsistent with the 2026-09-01 account in which Gagne died. All three statements stand as given.
